text:
Priya Nair: Proposal: 'SI Accelerator Track' — a short, modular enablement for systems integrators. Core goals: predictable onboarding, a lab-run cert, and a marketplace-ready checklist. Thoughts?

Owen Clarke: Love the modular idea. Suggest 3 micro-paths: Integrator Essentials, Ops & Marketplace, Hardware Validation. Each path = ~3 hours of content + 2-hour hands-on lab.

Maya Singh: Let's make the cert badges machine-readable (open badge) so SIs can show status in partner portal. Levels: Integrator, Architect, Publisher.

Tom Becker: Sandbox ops note: we'll provision ephemeral sandboxes per SI with RBAC and telemetry. Baseline cost per sandbox (no GPU) ~ $1.2k; add GPU node ~$1.8k extra. Recommend capacity limit 3 concurrent sandboxes for pilot.

Priya Nair: Good. Pilot scope: 4 SIs, run over 3 weeks, initial co-marketing only after 1 Gold-level win. Budget ask to finance ~ $10k (infra + promo).

Hannah Ortiz: PR input: we can push a short announcement if we have a customer quote and a joint demo. Recommend aligning PR timeline with marketing assets.

Owen Clarke: Trainer plan: record short lectures, live Q&A twice per cohort, and a final practical lab. I can own the labs.

partner-bot: Reminder: Create course shell 'SI-Accelerator-2026' in LMS and assign it to the Partnerships team by 2026-05-08.

Maya Singh: Marketplace checklist items (draft):
- listing manifest (JSON)
- logo + screenshots
- public docs link + integration guide
- verified billing flow + sandbox tokens
- hardware compatibility notes
- co-marketing blurb and contacts

Tom Becker: Quick CLI for sandbox creation (staging):
```
redwoodctl sandbox create --name si-<company> --env staging --ttl 72h --gpu optional
# returns: jumpbox_url, admin_token, metrics_endpoint
```
Use this to automate lab setup.

Priya Nair: Certification rubric suggestion: deploy end-to-end integration (50%), run smoke & failover tests (30%), submit runbook + marketplace manifest (20%). Pass = 80%+.

Hannah Ortiz: For the announcement playbook, we need a timeline: pilot complete -> 2 weeks for case study -> joint webinar. Also coordinate legal for co-branding approvals.

Owen Clarke: I'll draft the lab scenarios: model deploy, routing policy test, fallback to cheaper model, and a simulated spike to validate autoscaling. Will post by Tue.

Maya Singh: I'll prepare the open-badge spec and a sample listing JSON. Also will create a short eval harness (curl-based) partners can run locally.

partner-bot: Action created: tasks/si-accelerator/setup-infra, assigned to Tom Becker. Due 2026-04-30.

Priya Nair: Volunteers: Owen = labs & trainer, Maya = marketplace + badges, Tom = sandbox ops, Hannah = PR/marketing coordination. I'll be partner PM.

Hannah Ortiz: I'll draft a one-pager for sales and post to drive by EOD Friday. Also looping in legal for brand checklist.

Tom Becker: Will list required SKUs and expected cost per cohort in the ops doc.

Priya Nair: Next steps: capture action items in Notion, schedule 30m sync for Fri 10am PT. Thanks all! :rocket:
